title: Imperfectly Imperfect: Evaluating Graded Cognitive Diversity in LLM Persona Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2611.10508v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in social, behavioural, and decision-making research, yet it remains unclear whether they can express graded cognitive diversity as assigned when engaging in simulated behaviour. We introduce a cognition-suite evaluation that tests whether simulated populations reproduce human variation in reasoning, self-reported traits, their associations, and downstream behaviour. Agents conditioned on synthetic or human-derived profiles of cognitive reflection, Need for Cognition, and Big Five personality answer the same suite as a cohort of 473 adults: two newly assembled tests, a Cognitive Reflection Test (CRT) and a Behavioural Reflection Test (BRT) whose decision scenarios measure reflection in behaviour, alongside an established CRT and the two trait questionnaires. translated_title: 不完美的不完美：评估大语言模型人格模拟中的分级认知多样性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益被用作社会、行为和决策研究中的合成参与者，然而它们在进行模拟行为时能否表现出按设定赋予的分级认知多样性仍不清楚。我们引入了一套认知组合评估，用于检验模拟人群能否复现人类在推理、自我报告特质、二者的关联以及下游行为方面的个体差异。以合成或源自真实人类的认知反思、认知需求和大五人格画像为条件的智能体，与473名成年人组成的队列回答相同的测试组合：包括两个新编制的测试——认知反思测试（CRT）和行为反思测试（BRT，其决策情境测量行为层面的反思），以及一个已有的CRT和两份特质问卷。在对四个模型进行的七次全套测试模拟运行中，智能体重现了认知需求……（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一套认知组合评估方法，检验在被赋予认知反思、认知需求与大五人格画像后，大语言模型智能体能否复现人类的分级认知多样性及其与下游行为的关联。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a cognition-suite evaluation testing whether LLM agents conditioned on profiles of cognitive reflection, Need for Cognition, and Big Five personality can reproduce graded human cognitive diversity in reasoning, traits, and downstream behavior.
